visualize_densepose_vertex_outputs: visualize DensePose CSE predictions on an image using vertex XYZ embeddings as RGB colors
visualize_densepose_texture_outputs: visualize DensePose predictions on an image by mapping texture atlas colors onto detected bounding boxes
get_xyz_vertex_embedding: get a cached normalized vertex embedding map from a mesh name for visualization purposes
get_texture_atlases: parse a JSON string of mesh name to texture atlas paths and load the corresponding texture images
generate_image_with_texture: generate a textured image by mapping UV coordinates from a mesh onto a texture atlas with alpha blending
